name: K10 Single SIM Smart Watch with Calling Function
description:
Type	Smart Watch
SIM	Single SIM
Display	1.54" inch LCD 240 x 240p HD Display
CPU	MTK2502
RAM	32MB
Internal Memory	32MB

Magnetic charging cable
